exposure: timing of driving simulator testing (2-3 weeks vs 5-6 weeks postpartum)
cohort: 38 postnatal women who were regular drivers and had given birth
finding: There was no difference in driving capability at 2-3 weeks vs 5-6 weeks postpartum, nor by mode of birth, suggesting that women may be able to safely resume driving sooner than commonly advised after cesarean section.
mod_finding: There was no difference in driving capability between women who gave birth vaginally, by elective cesarean section, or by emergency cesarean section.
